svg.title: The dihexa paper trail: 4 of 6 key papers flagged
svg.desc: The dihexa paper trail: 4 of 6 key papers flagged. 2010, Norleual as an HGF/c-Met inhibitor: No notice listed. 2011, Truncated Nle1-AngIV analogs and synapse growth: No notice listed. 2011, HGF dimerization-domain mimics, anti-cancer: Retracted, 2025. 2012, AngIV analogs as HGF/Met modifiers: Retracted, 2025. 2013, Dihexa discovery paper (oral, brain-penetrant): Expression of concern, 2021. 2014, Dihexa works through HGF/c-Met (mechanism): Retracted, 2025.
